label: copy-phase input v (rare subset)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the copy phase when the fed-back input token is v (96% of activation mass); essentially never in the original phase or at <DEL>. The remaining ~4% are copy-phase inputs t or 3, often directly before a v. However it fires on only ~3% of copy-phase v inputs, and which ones is not captured by simple variables: rate is enriched when the current output is v/u/t/2/3/c (a following v gives the strongest, e.g. v v pairs), when the previous token is o/l/i/m/b, and around recall_idx 3, but combining these only reaches F1 ~0.31. Top activations are on a v followed by another v in the copy. Magnitude is small (mean 0.13).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=v (+5.96), phase=2 & in_tok=t (+4.73), in_tok=3 (+4.08), phase=2 & out_tok=v (+3.77), in_tok=v (+3.07), phase=2 & out_tok=u (+2.54). Lower it: out_tok=r (-3.09), out_tok=a (-2.83), prev_tok=y (-2.70), out_tok=n (-2.64).
